jurisdictions.F2: COM: a small intake/permit-tech team (same 3-5 names across both completeness cycles, e.g. Mark Celestino, Juan Alvarado, Christopher Delgado) - not discipline reviewers. Zoning completeness = permitted-use verification by the same team. LAND-PLAT: discipline/agency reviewers (SAWS, Engineering Trees, Engineering TIA, CPS Energy, TCI) each run their own completeness review.
jurisdictions.F3: Written comments the applicant must answer, iterating (Additional Information Required -> Additional Information Received). Content is administrative: missing/unsigned/unsealed documents, wrong permit type, valuation, missing uploads; zoning completeness is a one-line permitted-use check ('Verification of Permitted Use only ... UDC Zoning review pending'). Of 6,051 COM completeness AIR comments, ~75% match document/upload/seal/permit-type vocabulary; even code-term matches were administrative on inspection.
jurisdictions.F6: STRONG: separate review_cycle values 'Completeness Review', 'Completeness Review Zoning', 'Application Intake' distinct from 'Technical Review' on ~36k rows/~20k records.
jurisdictions.read: Distinct, named, comment-issuing pre-technical stage with its own clock (3 business days). Comments are admin/document deficiencies, not substantive plan-review comments. Tier A on F1/F5/F6 shape; F3 content is closer to B. Note site plan in SA is reviewed inside the commercial building permit (COM-PRJ-APP), not a standalone site plan application.
